archetypes.name: stall-recovery
archetypes.rationale: The new permanent bail class must preserve retry and resume semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stall recovery classifier, retry policy, and tests for class consistency. Check that submodule-edit-required-out-of-scope wins over stale transient evidence and still emits a Step 2 resume hint. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scout-normalize
archetypes.rationale: Review pre-scout normalization now depends on the shared Python filter mode.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the dispatch-panel normalization path and plan_scout mode handling together. Check fallback behavior, mode-specific reserved slugs, and that downstream validation still guards the normalized manifest. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
